also: put it in the laundry basket

terms.comment: A description of ours: corbis, the lexicon’s basket, with lavandāria, “things to be washed” (see “laundry”). We have found no word for a laundry basket in Traupman, Morgan–Owens, or Levi–Bini.

phrases.latin: Vestīmenta sordida in corbem lavandāriōrum conjice.
phrases.english: Throw your dirty clothes in the laundry basket.

phrases.latin: Corbis lavandāriōrum jam plēna est; lavandum est.
phrases.english: The laundry basket is full already; it’s time to do the washing.

sources: Lewis & Short: corbis · Lewis & Short: lavandaria
